column1: # --bypass: at each cutoff hit, extend the probe with probability p^c,
#   where p = fraction of past probe-bests strictly worse than current
#   stats.tmp (capped at 0.99) and c = # cutoff hits so far in this
#   probe. Trades restart frequency for "stay in the rare-good basin."
# --fixed=1: always use the default strategy at restart (current default).
#   that re-enables the random-strategy escape hatch -- strat.cached and
#   strat.pol get resampled per restart in 75% of cycles).
